basicSwitch.title: Basic mode (minimal dehumidifier tile + sensors)
basicSwitch.description: Keep the dehumidifier tile but strip its detail down to power on/off and current humidity only - no target-humidity slider, no fan, no mode switches. The current-humidity sensor and the water-tank-full sensor still appear as their own tiles. Turn off to restore the full dehumidifier controls.

country.title: Country code (2-letter ISO; sets the LG server region)
country.description: Use your LG ThinQ account's country, e.g. NZ, TW, AU, KR, US, GB. Not hard-coded. NZ and TW are both in the Asia-Pacific (kic) region.

tokenFile.title: Absolute path to the PAT token file (recommended)

token.title: Personal Access Token (if not using a token file)

deviceId.title: Device ID (required when you have more than one dehumidifier)

waterFullSensor.title: Water-full notification sensor type (Apple Home)
waterFullSensor.description: Apple Home only pushes alerts for certain sensor types. Contact is the quietest; Leak is closest in meaning but Apple raises a Critical Alert; None creates no sensor. The alert wording cannot be customized in the Home app (only the sensor's name).

modeSwitches.title: Mode switches to show in Home
modeSwitches.description: Only the ticked modes appear as on/off switches. The unit is always in exactly one mode, so they act as a radio group (turning one on switches to it). Leave everything unticked to show no mode switches.

showHumiditySensor.title: Show a separate humidity sensor tile
showHumiditySensor.description: The main dehumidifier tile already shows the current humidity. Enable this only if you want a standalone humidity sensor for separate automations or history.
